ledger='docs/ops/audits/code-quality-file-ledger.md';header='| 文件 | 类别 | 状态 | 证据 / 验证 | 备注 |'

 head,rest=b.decode().split(header,1);body,tail=rest.split('\n\n',1)
 return head,{x.split('|')[1].strip():x for x in body.splitlines() if x.startswith('| `')},tail
bh,br,bt=split(blob(ledger));ch,cr,ct=split(Path(ledger).read_bytes());assert bt==ct and br.keys()==cr.keys()

 assert cr['`'+p+'`'].split('|')[3].strip()=='review'
p='docs/ops/board.md';old=blob(p).decode().splitlines();new=Path(p).read_text().splitlines();assert len(old)==len(new)
diffs=[(a,b) for a,b in zip(old,new) if a!=b];assert len(diffs)==1 and diffs[0][0].startswith('| QUALITY-PRE94-RETROSPECTIVE-1 |')
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff',base,'--','packages','scripts','docs/ops/evidence/QUALITY-PRE94-RETROSPECTIVE-1/queue.json'])==b''
meta={'20261004-semantic-current-batch.json':['docs/ops/board.md'],'20261016-historical-cards-d.json':[ledger],'20261017-r93-phase-governance-artifacts.json':['docs/phase-governance/reviews/20261004-semantic-current-batch.json','docs/phase-governance/reviews/20261016-historical-cards-d.json'],'20261017-r94-final-machine-artifacts.json':['docs/phase-governance/reviews/20261017-r93-phase-governance-artifacts.json']}
for name,paths in meta.items():
 p='docs/phase-governance/reviews/'+name;b=json.loads(blob(p));a=json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
 assert {k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!='entries'}=={k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!='entries'}
 assert len(a['entries'])==len(b['entries'])
 for before,after in zip(b['entries'],a['entries']):
  if before['path'] not in paths:assert before==after,(p,before['path']);continue
  assert after['revision']['history'][1:]==before['revision']['history']
  assert after['afterSha256']==hashlib.sha256(Path(after['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  unchanged=['sourceSha256','provenance','truthAnchors','history','sourceGitRevision','primarySource']
  for k in unchanged:
